currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.

billing.meter_event_sessions.create.title: Create Billing Meter Event Session
billing.meter_event_sessions.create.description: Create a v2 authentication session for the high-throughput meter event stream. Tokens last 15 minutes. files.create.title: Create File
files.create.description: Upload a file to Stripe as multipart/form-data. The handwritten handler posts purpose and file bytes to files.stripe.com. Maps to STRIPE_CREATE_FILE. Official POST https://files.stripe.com/v1/files. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/files/create.

file_name.description: File name sent in the multipart Content-Disposition header.

file_link_create.description: When true, also create a file link for the uploaded file.

file_link_expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the created file link expires. Implies file_link_data[create]=true.

terminal.onboarding_links.create.title: Create Terminal Onboarding Link
terminal.onboarding_links.create.description: Create a Tap to Pay on iPhone onboarding link. Maps to STRIPE_CREATE_TERMINAL_ONBOARDING_LINK. Official POST /v1/terminal/onboarding_links. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/terminal/onboarding-link/create.

link_type.description: The type of onboarding link. Currently only apple_terms_and_conditions.

merchant_display_name.description: Business name shown while the merchant accepts Apple terms.

on_behalf_of.description: Connected account id (acct_...) to create the link for.

test_helpers.confirmation_tokens.create.title: Create Test Confirmation Token
test_helpers.confirmation_tokens.create.description: Create a test-mode ConfirmationToken. Live keys are rejected by Stripe. Maps to STRIPE_CREATE_TEST_CONFIRMATION_TOKEN. Official POST /v1/test_helpers/confirmation_tokens. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/confirmation_tokens/test_create.

return_url.description: URL to redirect the customer after authentication.

setup_future_usage.description: How to save the payment method.

payment_method_data_type.description: Payment method type when creating payment_method_data inline, such as card.

invoices.detach_payment.title: Detach Payment from Invoice
invoices.detach_payment.description: Detach a PaymentIntent or PaymentRecord from an invoice. Maps to STRIPE_DETACH_PAYMENT_FROM_INVOICE. Official POST /v1/invoices/{{invoice}}/detach_payment. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/detach_payment.

files.contents.title: Download File Contents
files.contents.description: Download authenticated file bytes from files.stripe.com and return them as base64. Maps to STRIPE_DOWNLOAD_FILE_CONTENTS. Official GET https://files.stripe.com/v1/files/{{file}}/contents. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/file-upload#download-file-contents.

quotes.pdf.title: Download Quote PDF
quotes.pdf.description: Download the PDF for a finalized quote from files.stripe.com and return it as base64. Maps to STRIPE_DOWNLOAD_QUOTE_PDF. Official GET https://files.stripe.com/v1/quotes/{{quote}}/pdf. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/quotes/pdf.

tax.associations.find.title: Find Tax Association
tax.associations.find.description: Find the tax association linked to a PaymentIntent. Maps to STRIPE_FIND_TAX_ASSOCIATION. Official GET /v1/tax/associations/find. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/tax/associations/find.

test_helpers.customers.fund_cash_balance.title: Fund Test Cash Balance
test_helpers.customers.fund_cash_balance.description: Fund a test-mode customer cash balance. Maps to STRIPE_FUND_TEST_CASH_BALANCE. Official POST /v1/test_helpers/customers/{{customer}}/fund_cash_balance. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/cash_balance_transactions/fund_cash_balance.

amount.description: Amount to fund in the smallest currency unit.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.

reference.description: Free-text reference that simulates a customer bank-transfer memo.

credit_notes.preview_lines.list.title: List Credit Note Preview Lines
credit_notes.preview_lines.list.description: List the line items a credit note preview would include. Maps to STRIPE_GET_CREDIT_NOTES_PREVIEW_LINES. Official GET /v1/credit_notes/preview/lines. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/credit_notes/preview_lines.

invoice.description: Invoice id (in_...) to preview credit note lines for.

amount.description: Total credit note amount in the smallest currency unit.

memo.description: Memo that would appear on the credit note PDF.

email_type.description: Email type to send the customer.

effective_at.description: Unix timestamp when the credit note takes effect.

credit_amount.description: Amount to credit to the customer balance, in the smallest currency unit.

refund_amount.description: Amount to refund, in the smallest currency unit.

out_of_band_amount.description: Amount credited outside Stripe, in the smallest currency unit.

starting_after.description: A cursor for pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list; fetching starts after this object.

ending_before.description: A cursor for pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list; fetching ends before this object.

customers.subscriptions.discount.get.title: Retrieve Customer Subscription Discount
customers.subscriptions.discount.get.description: Retrieve the discount on a customer's subscription. Maps to STRIPE_GET_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER_SUBS_SUB_EXPOSED_ID_DISCOUNT. Official GET /v1/customers/{{customer}}/subscriptions/{{subscription_exposed_id}}/discount. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/discounts/subscription_delete.

expand.description: Field to expand, such as coupon.

analytics.mrr.query.title: Query Monthly Recurring Revenue
analytics.mrr.query.description: Query Stripe-defined monthly recurring revenue from the Analytics API. POST is the public query method; the call does not mutate billing data. Maps to STRIPE_GET_MONTHLY_RECURRING_REVENUE. Official POST /v2/data/analytics/metric_query with metrics[0].name=revenue.mrr. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/data/analytics.

starts_at.description: Range start as an ISO 8601 datetime with a timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for time bucket boundaries.

group_by.description: Dimensions to group the MRR series by.

filters.description: Filter map of dimension name to a list of IDs, such as price.

payment_attempt_records.get.title: Retrieve Payment Attempt Record
payment_attempt_records.get.description: Retrieve a Payment Attempt Record. Maps to STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_RECORDS_ID. Official GET /v1/payment_attempt_records/{{id}}. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-attempt-record/retrieve.

payment_records.get.title: Retrieve Payment Record
payment_records.get.description: Retrieve a Payment Record. Maps to STRIPE_GET_PAYMENT_RECORD. Official GET /v1/payment_records/{{id}}. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/retrieve.

payment_attempt_records.list.title: List Payment Attempt Records
payment_attempt_records.list.description: List Payment Attempt Records for a Payment Record. Maps to STRIPE_LIST_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_RECORDS. Official GET /v1/payment_attempt_records. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-attempt-record/list.

payment_record.description: Payment Record id (pr_...) to list attempts for.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

starting_after.description: A cursor for pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list; fetching starts after this object.

ending_before.description: A cursor for pagination. Object ID that defines your place in the list; fetching ends before this object.

subscriptions.migrate.title: Migrate Subscription
subscriptions.migrate.description: Migrate a subscription from classic to flexible billing mode. Maps to STRIPE_MIGRATE_SUBSCRIPTION. Official POST /v1/subscriptions/{{subscription}}/migrate. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/migrate.

billing_mode_type.description: Billing mode to migrate to. Must be flexible.

payment_records.report_payment.title: Report Payment
payment_records.report_payment.description: Report a new Payment Record for an on- or off-Stripe payment. Maps to STRIPE_POST_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_PAYMENT. Official POST /v1/payment_records/report_payment. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/report.

amount_currency.description: Currency of the requested amount, such as usd.

amount_value.description: Requested amount in the smallest currency unit.

initiated_at.description: Unix timestamp when the payment was initiated.

payment_method_details_type.description: Payment method type. Use custom for off-Stripe methods.

payment_method_details_display_name.description: Display name when payment_method_details type is custom.

payment_method_details_payment_method.description: Stripe PaymentMethod id (pm_...) when the method is on Stripe.

processor_details_type.description: Processor type. Use custom for an external processor.

processor_details_payment_reference.description: External processor payment reference. Required when the processor type is custom.

description.description: Arbitrary description of the payment.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome, when reporting a finished payment.

guaranteed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the payment was guaranteed.

customers.funding_instructions.create.title: Create Customer Funding Instructions
customers.funding_instructions.create.description: Create or retrieve bank-transfer funding instructions for a customer cash balance. eu_bank_transfer_country.description: Two-letter country code required for eu_bank_transfer.

payment_records.report_payment_attempt.title: Report Payment Attempt
payment_records.report_payment_attempt.description: Report a new payment attempt on a Payment Record. Maps to STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_ATTEMPT. Official POST /v1/payment_records/{{id}}/report_payment_attempt. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/report_payment_attempt.

initiated_at.description: Unix timestamp when the attempt was initiated.

guaranteed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the attempt was guaranteed.

payment_method.description: PaymentMethod id (pm_...) used for this attempt.

payment_records.report_payment_attempt_c.title: Report Payment Attempt Canceled
payment_records.report_payment_attempt_c.description: Report that the latest payment attempt was canceled. Maps to STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_CANCELED. Official POST /v1/payment_records/{{id}}/report_payment_attempt_canceled. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/report_payment_attempt_canceled.

canceled_at.description: Unix timestamp when the attempt was canceled.

payment_records.report_payment_attempt_g.title: Report Payment Attempt Guaranteed
payment_records.report_payment_attempt_g.description: Report that the latest payment attempt was guaranteed. Maps to STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_GUARANTEED. Official POST /v1/payment_records/{{id}}/report_payment_attempt_guaranteed. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/report_payment_attempt_guaranteed.

guaranteed_at.description: Unix timestamp when the attempt was guaranteed.

payment_records.report_payment_attempt_i.title: Report Payment Attempt Information
payment_records.report_payment_attempt_i.description: Report informational updates on a Payment Record. Maps to STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_INFO. customer_email.description: Customer email to record on the attempt.

customer_name.description: Customer name to record on the attempt.

customer_phone.description: Customer phone to record on the attempt.

payment_records.report_refund.title: Report Payment Record Refund
payment_records.report_refund.description: Report that the latest payment attempt was refunded. Maps to STRIPE_POST_V1_PAYMENT_RECORDS_REPORT_REFUND_OVERVIEW. Official POST /v1/payment_records/{{id}}/report_refund. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment-record/report_refund.

processor_details_type.description: Processor type. Use custom for an external processor.

refund_reference.description: External processor refund reference. Required when the processor type is custom.

amount_value.description: Refunded amount in the smallest currency unit.

terminal.readers.present_payment_method.title: Present Test Payment Method
terminal.readers.present_payment_method.description: Present a simulated payment method on a test-mode Terminal reader. Maps to STRIPE_PRESENT_PAYMENT_METHOD. payment_records.report_payment_attempt_f.title: Report Payment Attempt Failed

terminal.readers.succeed_input_collectio.title: Succeed Test Input Collection
terminal.readers.succeed_input_collectio.description: Simulate a successful Terminal reader input collection. Test mode only. Maps to STRIPE_SUCCEED_TEST_TERMINAL_READER_INPUT_COLLECTION. terminal.readers.timeout_input_collectio.title: Timeout Test Input Collection

v2.core.event_destinations.update.title: Update v2 Event Destination
v2.core.event_destinations.update.description: Update a v2 event destination. v2 APIs use JSON bodies. Maps to STRIPE_UPDATE_EVENT_DESTINATION. Official POST /v2/core/event_destinations/{{id}}. Docs: https://docs.stripe.com/api/v2/core/event-destinations/update.
